questions.question: What did God promise Solomon if he walked faithfully?
options: To grant him many wives and sons
To make him richer than all kings
To give him a long and healthy life

questions.question: What did God warn would happen if Israel turned to other gods?
options: Israel would be cut off and the temple rejected
A short famine would warn the people
A mild rebuke would come through a prophet
Nothing would change for many years
questions.answer: Israel would be cut off and the temple rejected

questions.question: God appeared to Solomon a second time after the temple was finished.
God promised to establish Solomon's royal _____ over Israel forever if he obeyed.
God warned that disobedience would cause Israel to be cut off from the _____ he gave them.
